answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can enter a trellis of tasks. Randomly assigned verification jobs test each identity, while rewards track audited useful work rather than identity count; a failed audit forfeits the stake. A Sybil attacker must therefore tie up capital and spend compute on every fake agent, with losses scaling alongside the swarm. Even at the zenith of an attack, cheap account creation cannot create influence for free.
